## Predictability vs. the hidden economics

The strength of having your own foundation is not only ownership, but also predictability.

The platform economy has many components, and they differ for each scenario. For products: commissions, paid visibility, returns, penalties. For services: fees for access to leads and dependence on ratings. They all share one thing: the final amount is difficult to plan in advance.

I am deliberately not citing "market average" percentages here.

Instead, a more useful exercise: **calculate your own numbers**. How? Take your last 12 months, add up all deductions, paid access to leads, advertising, and fees. Then look at the net amount that actually reached you.

I propose a different logic - **a fixed base price and written commitments**. In my model, this is €70/month plus €200 for activation, with written SLAs and compensation mechanisms if they are breached.

The principle matters more than the details: you know in advance what you are paying for and how much. And you understand the boundary - what is included in the base and what is discussed separately.
